section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction section reviews literature on positive body image and body appreciation, establishing the theoretical framework for 'the present study.' The section discusses qualitative research by Wood-Barcalow et al. (2010) with college women and Frisén & Holmqvist (2010) with Swedish adolescents, but provides no empirical data (sample sizes, demographics, or correlations) about the present study itself. The introduction outlines the conceptual model to be tested, incorporating interpersonal variables (caregiver eating messages, attachment) and intrapersonal variables (perfectionism) as predictors of body appreciation, with depressive symptoms and intuitive eating as outcomes.
